[EN] Strange Golem
[ES] Gólem extraño
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Please get samples of the {@creature:46#7001$$tholzak emitter} for me.
[ES] Por favor, consigue muestras del {@creature:46#7001$$tholzak emisor} para mí.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Thanks a lot for bringing the samples.
[ES] Muchas gracias por traer las muestras.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find and break the {@creature:46#7001$$tholzak emitter} in the {@Rgn:46018$$Three Towers Upper Level} and collect tholzak emitter element.
[ES] Busca y rompe el {@creature:46#7001$$tholzak emisor} en {@Rgn:46018$$Three Towers Upper Level} y recolecta el elemento emisor de tholzak.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "It's an honor to serve."
[ES] "Es un honor servir."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Collect tholzak emitter elements.
[ES] Recolecta elementos emisores de tholzak.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to the {@Rgn:46019$$Beastroar Chamber} and deliver the tholzak emitter elements to {@creature:246#1025$$Alecian}.
[ES] Ve a la {@Rgn:46019$$Beastroar Chamber} y entrégale los elementos del emisor tholzak a {@creature:246#1025$$Alecian}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
